records.jp: そっかぁ……。リーダーとして、ね……
records.en_original: Worried about leader stuff, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Worried about leader stuff, huh...
records.en: Worried about leader stuff, huh...

records.jp: 後から後から考えが浮かんできて……<CR>こうすればよかったんじゃないかって……
records.en_original: I just can't help but look back and wonder if I made the wrong decision...
records.en_auxiliary: I just can't help but look back and wonder if I made the wrong decision...
records.en: One thought after another keeps coming to me...<CR>wondering whether I should have done something differently...

records.jp: それで、どんどん正解が分からなくなっていって……
records.en_original: And the more I think about it, the less confident I get...
records.en_auxiliary: And the more I think about it, the less confident I get...
records.en: And the more I think about it, the less confident I get...

records.jp: 愛央って、責任感あるよね
records.en_original: You're like, super responsible, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You're like, super responsible, huh?
records.en: Ao, you really have a strong sense of responsibility.

records.jp: え？　どうして……？
records.en_original: Huh? What makes you say that?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What makes you say that?
records.en: Huh? What makes you say that?

records.jp: だって……愛央は今、落ち込んでるでしょ？
records.en_original: I mean... You're totally depressed now, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I mean... You're totally depressed now, right?
records.en: I mean... You're totally depressed now, right?

records.jp: そ、そうだけど……
records.en_original: W-well, yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, yeah...
records.en: W-well, yeah...

records.jp: 落ち込めるってことは、<CR>真剣に受け止めてるって証拠だよね
records.en_original: The fact you're taking it so hard just shows how seriously you take being leader.
records.en_auxiliary: The fact you're taking it so hard just shows how seriously you take being leader.
records.en: The fact that you're feeling this down<CR>shows how seriously you're taking it.

records.jp: 何かを最後までやり切るとか、責任持ってやるとか、<CR>あたしにはそういうのないからさ
records.en_original: You act knowing that it's your responsibility to see things until the end... I don't have anything like that.
records.en_auxiliary: You act knowing that it's your responsibility to see things until the end... I don't have anything like that.
records.en: Seeing something through, taking responsibility...<CR>I don't have anything like that.

records.jp: だから、愛央は偉い！　偉すぎる！
records.en_original: That's why you're amazing! Super-duper amazing!
records.en_auxiliary: That's why you're amazing! Super-duper amazing!
records.en: That's why you're amazing! Super-duper amazing!

records.jp: ……なんか、すごい励まし方された
records.en_original: That's one way to cheer a person up...
records.en_auxiliary: That's one way to cheer a person up...
records.en: That's one way to cheer a person up...

records.jp: はは……あたしバカだから。<CR>なんて言えばいいのかわかんないんだもん
records.en_original: Haha, I'm just a dummy who doesn't know what to say at times like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, I'm just a dummy who doesn't know what to say at times like this.
records.en: Haha... I'm an idiot.<CR>I don't know what to say.

records.jp: だったらせめて、いつも通りのテンションのほうが<CR>いいかなって
records.en_original: So I thought I'd at least try and stay as positive as I always do.
records.en_auxiliary: So I thought I'd at least try and stay as positive as I always do.
records.en: So I thought it might be better to act with my usual energy,<CR>at least.

records.jp: あはは……そうだね。すごく助かる
records.en_original: Ahaha... Yeah. It worked.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Yeah. It worked.
records.en: Ahaha... Yeah. That helps a lot.

records.jp: ……勇希が羨ましいな。<CR>そんなふうに、明るいほうへ考えられるのが
records.en_original: Honestly, I'm a little jealous of you. I wish I could be as positive as you are.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I'm a little jealous of you. I wish I could be as positive as you are.
records.en: Honestly, I'm a little jealous of you.<CR>I wish I could be as positive as you are.

records.jp: やだもん、暗いの。<CR>あたしはへらへら笑ってたい
records.en_original: Oh, come on, don't be like that! I just want to have fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, come on, don't be like that! I just want to have fun.
records.en: I hate gloomy things.<CR>I want to grin and laugh.

records.jp: 笑って生きてたい
records.en_original: I want to live with a smile on my face.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to live with a smile on my face.
records.en: I want to live with a smile.

records.jp: 泣いたりくよくよしてばかりより、<CR>そのほうが人生楽しいでしょ？
records.en_original: Don't you think it's easier to do that than to mope and cry all day?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you think it's easier to do that than to mope and cry all day?
records.en: Life is more fun that way than if you spend all<CR>your time crying and worrying, right?

records.jp: うん……その通りだと思う
records.en_original: Yeah... You have a point.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You have a point.
records.en: Yeah... You have a point.

records.jp: ……やっぱ、勇希に話してよかった
records.en_original: I'm glad I decided to talk with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad I decided to talk with you.
records.en: I'm glad I talked to Yuki after all.

records.jp: え？　どうして？
records.en_original: Huh? Why's that?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why's that?
records.en: What? Why?

records.jp: いつも明るい勇希を見てると、<CR>こっちまで元気が湧いてくるから
records.en_original: You're always so happy, it's infectious. I can't help but feel better being with you.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always so happy, it's infectious. I can't help but feel better being with you.
records.en: You're always so happy, it's infectious.<CR>I can't help but feel better being with you.

records.jp: えへへ、そう？<CR>じゃあ、もっと、ずっと元気でいないとね！
records.en_original: Ehehe, really? I'm happy to give you a happiness recharge anytime!
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe, really? I'm happy to give you a happiness recharge anytime!
records.en: Ehehe, really?<CR>Then I have to stay even more energetic, all the time!

records.jp: ……うん。これからもよろしくね、勇希
records.en_original: Yeah. I'll take you up on that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I'll take you up on that.
records.en: ...Yeah. I am counting on you from now on too, Yuki.

records.jp: でも、難しいんだよ
records.en_original: But it's tough, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: But it's tough, you know?
records.en: But it's hard.

records.jp: 勇希……？
records.en_original: Yuki...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...?
records.en: Yuki...?

records.jp: ずっと笑ってられるなんて嘘。<CR>だって人生、辛いこともたくさんあるでしょ？
records.en_original: Sometimes a smile is nothing but a sweet lie. Life can be so hard.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes a smile is nothing but a sweet lie. Life can be so hard.
records.en: It is a lie to say that anyone can smile forever.<CR>Life has plenty of painful things, right?

records.jp: だけど……だからこそ、あたしは嘘をつくんだ
records.en_original: But... That's exactly why I want to keep on smiling.
records.en_auxiliary: But... That's exactly why I want to keep on smiling.
records.en: But... that's exactly why I lie.

records.jp: ずっと笑顔でいる
records.en_original: Sometimes people need a nice white lie.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes people need a nice white lie.
records.en: I keep smiling.

records.jp: 笑顔でいればみんな幸せ。みんな楽しい。<CR>そうでしょ？
records.en_original: As long as I can keep smiling, that means everyone else can. Right?
records.en_auxiliary: As long as I can keep smiling, that means everyone else can. Right?
records.en: If I smile, everyone is happy. Everyone has fun.<CR>Right?

records.jp: ……勇希らしい考え方だね
records.en_original: ...That's just like you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's just like you.
records.en: ...That's just like you.

records.jp: 笑顔だって必要な嘘、か……<CR>私は勇希の笑顔に救われてたのかもしれないね
records.en_original: A sweet lie, huh... Now that I think about it, I think that smile has kept me going too.
records.en_auxiliary: A sweet lie, huh... Now that I think about it, I think that smile has kept me going too.
records.en: Even a smile can be a necessary lie...<CR>Maybe Yuki's smile has been saving me.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: うん？
records.en_original: Hm?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm?
records.en: Hm?

records.jp: もし本当に辛いときは、ちゃんと言ってね
records.en_original: If you ever feel like you can't keep it up, will you talk to me?
records.en_auxiliary: If you ever feel like you can't keep it up, will you talk to me?
records.en: But if things ever truly become painful, tell me properly.

records.jp: ま、気が向いたらね～
records.en_original: I guess if I feel like it!
records.en_auxiliary: I guess if I feel like it!
records.en: Well, if I feel like it.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>ずっと明るく<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>Constant Cheer<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>Constant Cheer<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>Constant Cheer<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
